reading.tests: Each control references complete current command specifications in test_commands by ID. Absolute repository prefixes are represented by {repo}; remaining command arguments, working directory, kind, timeouts and selected redteam oracles are preserved.
reading.mutation_sha256: SHA256 digests of exact UTF-8 find and replacement strings; mutation source remains in the four maintained harness catalogs.
reading.evidence: Up to two actual verdict-line excerpts per executed oracle. Pytest exception detail after the FAILED node is omitted. Leading/trailing whitespace and ANSI escapes are removed, and each excerpt is capped at 360 characters. matched_lines preserves the count; stdout_sha256 identifies the complete local oracle output.
reading.local_provenance: proofs.local_files_sha256 paths resolve beneath reports/remediation-2026-10-04/evidence/mutation. These raw logs/manifests are local ignored provenance, not published archive files. Only this compact extract is self-contained published evidence; it does not contain full tracebacks, source snapshots or response payloads.
reading.scope: The retained latest proofs cover every original ID. Historical setup failures, survivors and aborted attempts are not credited; total attempts include superseded completed runs and exclude the aborted contention attempt and independent supplemental probes.
